decisions.reason: Locked 'none' is right. The only retraction-related word in d7's footnote is 'Retraction Watch', which is the work/publication name (work=Retraction Watch, rendered in italics as the publication). Under 3.6 a warning needs a statement about the cited work, and the footnote makes none. The relation to the cited work is settled (it is the publication's name), so 'ambiguous' does not apply either; the guide's ambiguous examples are a title or a note. Borderline: a stricter reader could mark any 'Retraction' text ambiguous, but the guide's wording does not require it.
